title: OffChain presents Insiders Insight (Crypto, Blockchain, Tokens)
author: OffChain.social
description: Welcome to Insiders Insight where we get close and personal with individuals working in industries that are aiming to change the world. From tips and tricks on how to be successful, to discussing the issues that they think are important in life, this podcast aims to give you an intimate insight into their minds.
